Overview

Another piece in my High School AP Art portfolio, one of my first paintings of the year. It captures a realistic moonlanding scene based on the early Apollo missions.

Process / Additional Notes

I've always wanted to paint astronauts on the moon; exploring the depths of contrast and heavy negative space. I created the concept by mixing elements from several moonlanding photos together into a new composition. I initially used dark black Jesso to coat the canvas and to deepen the shadows.
